description: This file defines the PaymentAddress controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles displaying, saving, and managing customer payment addresses during checkout, including validation, session management, and interaction with models for customer addresses and custom fields.

classes.name: PaymentAddress
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer payment addresses during checkout, including display and modification functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the payment address form with existing customer addresses and custom fields.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes and validates the submitted payment address form, updates customer address data, and manages session state.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the selected address as the payment address in the session, with validation and redirection handling.
